dictionary.home.introDesc: Stately and surprisingly spacious apartment with garage (128.2 m²) with man-cave and dumbwaiter in the heart of Geraardsbergen. Are you looking for the comfort of an apartment, but do not want to miss the spacious feel of a single-family home? This unique apartment of no less than 128.2 m² combines historic character with modern living comfort, located in the bustling center of Geraardsbergen, the gateway to the beautiful Flemish Ardennes.
dictionary.home.sec1Title: Stately look and abundance of space
dictionary.home.sec1Desc: Upon arrival, the impressive front and back facade immediately stand out, giving the building a stately and prestigious appearance. Inside, you enjoy high-quality finishing everywhere with durable floorings and the ultimate comfort of underfloor heating powered by high-efficiency gas boiler.
dictionary.home.sec3Desc: No more carrying heavy groceries or trays on the stairs! A smart, compact service lift connects the kitchen on the second floor directly with the living room on the first floor. Serve meals and drinks in a heartbeat.
dictionary.home.sec4Title: Top location in the Flemish Ardennes
dictionary.home.sec4Desc: You live here right in the center of Geraardsbergen with shops, public transport, and cozy dining at walking distance. At the same time, cycle or walk straight into the nature of the Flemish Ardennes.
